inspection.method: Poppler rasterization at 120 dpi followed by whole-window contact-sheet review and original-resolution review of the pages affected by reflow and the public-answer boundary.

defects_and_resolution.defect: The first candidate placed the Bayes denominator beyond the right text edge.
defects_and_resolution.resolution: Reflowed the mathematically identical denominator into two stacked lines, rebuilt deterministically, rerendered, and verified it stays inside the text block.

defects_and_resolution.defect: The first candidate overfilled the bottom text block by about 40 pt.
defects_and_resolution.resolution: Tightened three prose passages and split two displayed probability calculations without changing mathematical or medical meaning; rebuilt and verified a clear bottom margin.

defects_and_resolution.defect: A remaining 7.9 pt prose overflow was reported by TeX after the first reflow pass.
defects_and_resolution.resolution: Shortened the marginal-probability transition without changing its meaning; the final Section 3.2 log window contains no non-frame overfull box at that location.

log_audit.section_window: from ch_probability/TeX/ch_probability.tex open through sampling_from_a_small_population.tex open
log_audit.result: No remaining content overflow in the admitted Section 3.2 prose or formulae. Repeated 22.61992 pt messages are the existing mdframed border mechanics and are visually contained. Underfull boxes were visually benign.

release_handling: The receipt is durable QA evidence. Raster renders and contact sheets are internal review artifacts and are excluded from the release payload.
